- Next: inspect found_smells and git status, then choose one concrete smell in src/ or tests/ and refactor it fully.

- Chose found smell file 2026-03-19-ha-startup-smell-1.md as the required improve-code-boundaries task.
- The target boundary issue is the redundant HA startup wrapper chain around HaRuntimeCtx/HaWorkerBootstrap/HaWorkerCtx.
- Next: inspect src/ha/startup.rs and related state definitions, then flatten the bootstrap path and remove the smell file when complete.

- Rewrote ha startup boundary: removed HaRuntimeRequest and HaWorker wrappers, changed bootstrap to accept existing HaObservedState/HaControlPlane + identity/poll interval, and stored HaRuntimeCtx directly in HaRuntimeBundle.
- Updated runtime/node.rs to construct the existing HA boundary types at the call site and run the HA worker directly through crate::ha::worker::run(ha.worker).
- Deleted the processed found_smells entry for ha-startup; next step is compile/lint fallout, then full required make lint and make test.

- make lint passed cleanly after the HA startup boundary reduction.
- make test passed: 232/232 tests passed under cargo nextest, but nextest reported 5 leaky tests in api::worker::tests; this should be tracked as a bug per repo instructions.
- Next: use add-bug skill to file the leak issue, then review git state, commit all required changes including .ralph updates, push, and run task_switch.
